notes: Source-provenance golden fixtures for bitfinex_spot (tBTCUSD, Bitfinex v2 public WebSocket). Connector subscribes to channel 'trades' and to the standard (non-raw) order book channel 'book' with prec P0 / freq F0 / len 25. Expected events are pinned by hand from the documented semantics and verified by driving the real BitfinexConnector parser.

sources.note: Trade channel messages: subscribe ack {"event":"subscribed","channel":"trades","chanId":19111,...}; snapshot [chanId, [[ID, MTS, AMOUNT, PRICE], ...]]; updates [chanId, 'te'|'tu', [ID, MTS, AMOUNT, PRICE]]. Docs: 'te' is the trade execution (immediate, amount may be revised), 'tu' is the confirmed trade update; MTS is epoch ms; AMOUNT > 0 = buy / < 0 = sell (negative amounts are sells).

semantics.side: AMOUNT sign is the taker side: positive -> 'buy', negative -> 'sell' (normalized on abs(AMOUNT) as qty)
semantics.te_vs_tu: only 'tu' (confirmed) frames emit; 'te' frames are skipped so the same trade is never double-counted — pinned by this case (the 'te' frame produces no event)

sources.note: Book channel messages (standard book, prec P0/freq F0/len 25): subscribe ack {"event":"subscribed","channel":"book","chanId":17082,...}; snapshot [chanId, [[PRICE, COUNT, AMOUNT], ...]]; update [chanId, [PRICE, COUNT, AMOUNT]]. Docs: COUNT = number of orders at the price level, COUNT 0 removes the level; AMOUNT = total size at the level, > 0 for bids / < 0 for asks; heartbeats are [chanId, 'hb'].

semantics.side: AMOUNT sign decides the side: > 0 -> bid row, < 0 -> ask row
semantics.ts_field: none — book frames carry no exchange event time: emitted ts is the local processing time with source_event_ts_ms=null / source_event_time_known=false / event_time_source='local'
semantics.delete_semantics: COUNT 0 = remove the level: the emitted update row keeps the price with an empty qty '' (applyDiff deletes it from the book)
semantics.single_level_updates: updates carry exactly one [PRICE, COUNT, AMOUNT] row; the emitted depth event holds only that row (bids or asks, the other side empty)
